title: Digital Pinball: Necronomicon
native_title: デジタルピンボール 「ネクロノミコン」
overview:
Digital Pinball: Necronomicon is the successor to Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators. Like the title indicates, the theme of and inspiration to the game is derived from the fictional book Necronomicon and the general work of horror author H.P. Lovecraft.

The game features three different tables, which can be played separately or in the so-called "Realms Mode", where you start with a fixed table and have to achieve a certain mount of progress to move on to the other tables.

Like with its predecessor, the tables are displayed in an isometric view, similar to the Pro Pinball series. There is an ingame manual which explains the scoring mechanics (which include a multiball mode) of each table. The game also offers a two player mode.
